description: Cloudflare Clef-Flash typed-decision service on one Spark, following amarjeet's transformers recipe: choice, noul and score questions answered over text and images in one forward pass through POST /v1/systemone, with no generated text. Decoder linears are converted to FP8 at load; the head and vision tower stay BF16. A 16384-token input limit bounds the profile and requests run one at a time. Memory is the creator's measurement (18.7 GiB steady, 22.8 GiB predicted load peak); physical Spark qualification is pending. Video is not served: the model takes frame lists, the platform decision API sends one video. Requires native System One gateway support.
title: Clef-Flash FP8 transformers single Spark
